title: Atomic Chat LiteRT-LM Runtime Manifest
description: Schema for the release catalog of the `litert-lm` engine build: Google's LiteRT-LM native library, shipped in the `litert-lm-api` PyPI wheels, which the core installs to run `.litertlm` models. One wheel per platform, pinned by an explicit PyPI URL, size and sha256; Windows releases may also list the `openvino` wheel the core unpacks for Intel NPUs on request. A published release is never rewritten; a fix is a new release on top. Cores skip releases whose `min_core_version` is newer than themselves or whose `abi` their binding does not support.

version.description: LiteRT-LM version, the PyPI version of litert-lm-api, e.g. 0.18.1.

published_at.description: PyPI upload time of the release. The core takes the newest installed release with a supported abi.

min_core_version.description: Oldest atomic-chat-core that understands this entry. Older cores skip it.

abi.description: Our number, not Google's: the set and signatures of the C API functions the core's binding reads. It changes when they change, even within a LiteRT-LM minor version. A core that does not know it skips the release.

notes_url.description: Upstream release notes page shown next to an update offer.

accelerators.description: Runtimes the core downloads only on an explicit prepare request, never with the build.

pypi_url.description: Direct file URL from the PyPI JSON API. Explicit, not a template: the path holds hash directories the version does not determine.

platform.description: Host platform the core selects on; never derived from the wheel name at runtime.

id.description: Intel NPU runtime; the core unpacks only its openvino/libs.

version.description: OpenVINO version; names the folder the core unpacks it into.
